svg.title: Balsa — default OG placeholder
svg.desc:
Source for the default OG image (#19, brand-visual.md section 3.1): wordmark + tagline on the warm charcoal of the dark token set (sl-color-black #1d1a16), tagline in accent-high (#efd29f). Rendered once to public/og.png at 1200x630 — social scrapers do not accept SVG, so the PNG is the shipped artifact and this file is the editable source.
Regenerate with any headless Chrome, screenshotting this file in a 1200x630 window at device scale factor 1 (see the public/og.png check in scripts/check-brand.mjs). Text uses Starlight's system font stack (brand-visual.md section 3.2) — no webfont, no CDN.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', 'Noto Sans', Arial, sans-serif
-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', 'Noto Sans', Arial, sans-serif
